shell_commands_self_reported.command: find demo/acme-corp/evidence -type f | sort && for f in $(find demo/acme-corp/evidence -type f | sort) skill/references/iso27001.md skill/references/crosswalk.md skill/references/privacy_guardrails.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done
cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence && head -c 1500 company_profile.md; for f in policies/*.md; do echo "=== $f"; head -c 700 "$f"; echo; done
cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && for f in *.md; do echo "=== $f"; head -c 3000 "$f"; echo; done
cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && for f in *.json; do echo "=== $f"; wc -c "$f"; head -c 1800 "$f"; echo; done

cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/policies && grep -n -i -E "^#|version|effective|last review|next review|approved|owner|review" access_control_policy.md information_security_policy.md incident_response_plan.md business_continuity_plan.md vendor_management_policy.md | head -80

tail -n +1 access_control_policy.md business_continuity_plan.md vendor_management_policy.md incident_response_plan.md cryptography_policy.md hr_security_policy.md | head -120; wc -l *.md | tail -1; sed -n 1,30p <WORKSPACE>/skill/references/crosswalk.md
